FORGE Build it together.

Build it small.

FORGE IDE is a lightweight place to turn an idea into working software using ordinary files you can read, change, share, and rebuild.

TRY THE PROJECT

Make a tiny build plan

Change the idea, add a useful capability, then mark work complete. The project card updates immediately.

3 files Ready to build

Current project

Plan progress 0 / 0
    WHY IT WORKS THIS WAY

    The project stays ordinary.

    01

    See the files

    This example is just /index.html, /styles.css, and /app.js.

    02

    Change the behavior

    Open /app.js, edit how the plan works, save, and run it again.

    03

    Keep the build understandable

    No framework or build pipeline is needed for this project. The browser already knows how to run it.

    04

    Take it with you

    The same ordinary files can be exported, shared, or moved into a larger application when the idea earns it.

    OPEN THE FILES TAB

    This page is the example.

    There is no separate tutorial layer. Inspect the three files, change the wording or behavior, and use Re-run to see your version.

    HTML/index.html
    CSS/styles.css
    JS/app.js
    FORGE - Build it together. FORGE IDE - Build it small.
